dossier_metadata.subject: MAG45 B.V.
dossier_metadata.privacy_disclaimer: A complete, public employee roster is not available. Under the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Dutch privacy laws (AVG), companies are strictly prohibited from publishing comprehensive, searchable directories of employees' personal data without explicit, individual consent.

company_overview.founding_context: Originally established as an internal MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) warehousing and logistics specialist for the Dutch manufacturing giant Philips.

headquarters.address: De Schakel 20, 5651 GH Eindhoven, Noord-Brabant, The Netherlands

company_overview.industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain, and Storage / Industrial Integrator
company_overview.specialization: Integrated tail supply management, strategic sourcing, inventory optimization, and supply chain process engineering.

acquisition_details.acquirer: Solar A/S (Danish-listed sourcing and services company)
acquisition_details.strategic_rationale: To enable MAG45 to utilize the combined expertise, scale, and resources of Solar A/S to support global integrated supply initiatives.

business_model_and_services.core_value_proposition: Simplifying complex supply chains through integrated tail supply management, lowering Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and ensuring reliability, compliance, and peace of mind for clients so they can focus on core business activities.
key_service_offerings: Resident Engineering (on-site supply chain experts embedded in client facilities)
Supply Chain Compliance and Risk Management
notable_clients: Leading high-tech and med-tech manufacturers (featured in anonymized case studies)

corporate_management.name: Bauke Zeinstra
corporate_management.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
corporate_management.notes: Also Senior Vice President at Solar. Joined MAG45 in 2014, leads global growth with a people-first leadership approach.

corporate_management.name: Marc van de Ven
corporate_management.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
corporate_management.notes: Oversees global operations and day-to-day business management.

corporate_management.name: Bart Griffijn
corporate_management.title: Chief Procurement Officer (CPO)
corporate_management.notes: Leads the global sourcing and procurement strategy for all operational hubs.

corporate_management.name: Ronald Mulders
corporate_management.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
corporate_management.notes: Manages financial strategy, reporting, and fiscal health.

corporate_management.name: Dirk van den Hengel
corporate_management.title: Chief Commercial Officer (CCO)
corporate_management.notes: Joined in 2007 as a logistics engineer, grew through leadership roles to combine commercial strategy with customer value.

corporate_management.name: Carolien Poelman
corporate_management.title: Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)
corporate_management.notes: Joined in 2015, oversees HR strategy, talent acquisition, and employee development.

company_culture_and_development.internal_academy: Operates its own 'MAG45 Academy' providing diverse internal and external training and upskilling programs.
company_culture_and_development.community_impact: Actively participates in regional initiatives to help young professionals in the Brabant area enter the workforce.
company_culture_and_development.work_style: Cross-functional, hands-on, pragmatic, and focused on turning supply chain analysis into practical, day-to-day operational improvements.

market_position_and_financial_context.parent_company_scale: Solar Group is a Danish-listed company with approximately €1.7 billion in annual revenue.
market_position_and_financial_context.competitive_advantage: Over 75 years of experience in supply for complex production environments, specialized in fragmented 'tail' supply which is often overlooked by traditional strategic sourcing models.
recent_milestones: 2023: Celebrated '75 Years in Motion', tracing company history back to its 1948 origins.
2024: Published thought leadership on supply chain compliance ('Thousands of Suppliers, Millions of Parts: How to Stay Compliant?').

digital_footprint_and_contact_channels.knowledge_hub: Offers whitepapers and the 'Tail Supply Conductors' podcast detailing integrated supply strategies and TCO reduction.
